insights.title: Portfolio expands to 50 tracked materials, prices broadly softening
insights.text: The tracked universe expands to 50 raw materials this cycle, adding granular price points across corn, soybean, wheat, and palm oil trade terms; the portfolio-wide average move is -5.8% week-on-week.

insights.title: Sharp swings in soybean and sunflower meal pricing
insights.text: Soybean CFR posted the steepest weekly gain at +33.6%, while Sunflower Meal fell 46.5% WoW; 18 of 50 materials moved more than ±10% week-on-week, underscoring elevated short-term volatility.

insights.title: Limestone Powder cheapest, Fish Oil most expensive
insights.text: Limestone Powder remains the lowest-priced tracked material at $35/MT, while Fish Oil is now the most expensive at roughly $3,638/MT.

insights.title: Calcium Phosphate flagged as the highest cost-risk item
insights.text: Calcium Phosphate carries the only confirmed High Cost signal in the portfolio, with Akij's China sourcing priced well above the Morocco benchmark; 15 additional materials are flagged for supplier review.

insights.title: China and India dominate specialty and wheat sourcing
insights.text: China remains the primary source for amino acids and mineral additives (L-Methionine, Calcium Phosphate, PH Raw Materials, L-Lysine, L-Threonine, Amino Acid Feed, Feed Additive), while India has become the default sourcing origin across the newly expanded wheat and RSM lines.
